state:
Goal `core-validate-and-1-more`: `Core\Validate::isAscii`, `isDomain` and `isEmail` are finished. Each has its about page, three examples, a bench with its figure in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`, an attack, a Rust `covers:` test and a plain card.
`isIp`, `isMac` and `isPrintable` still owe everything but their Novis tests, and their cards are still in the dense "Answers whether …" voice.
`Core\Xml` (the check `dossier-core-xml`) has not been started: it owes its class card and all proofs for `parse`, `reader` and `writer`.
Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Validate::isMac`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). The Rust test at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:802` needs only a `// covers: Core\Validate::isMac` line above its `#[test]`. Rewrite the card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:305` in the plain voice. `docs/examples/core/Validate/isDomain/` is the model. The bench declares `allocations 0` and `calls 0`, indexes with `(($total + $i) % 3) as int` and adds a multiple of 3 on every path. `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Validate'` writes the figure after the last edit to `validate.rs`.

**`Core\Validate::isIp`** — the same list. No Rust test exists: write one marked `covers: Core\Validate::isIp`, in the shape of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:828`, covering `{version: 4}`, `{version: 6}`, a leading zero and a zone id. Card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:283`; its `version` option is a literal union, so one example shows `{version: 6}`.

**`Core\Validate::isPrintable`** — the same list, and no Rust test either: write one in the shape of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:828`. Card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:335`. Its about page says how it differs from `isAscii` (tab and newline are `false`, `é` is `true`).

backlog: `Core\Xml`: class card plus proofs for `parse`, `reader`, `writer` — the check `dossier-core-xml`; `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs` and the `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` list in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`.

`crates/nvs-cli/src/worker.rs:2837`'s drain-deadline test fails under full-workspace load; its bound needs to hold under load (`tools/nv/cmd/verify.ts`'s module doc). The playbook bullet under *Running things* owns the workaround.
